Name: Custom_Board
Description:
- Place scripted miniatures on this board and press "Extend KT UI"
- Access movement and LOS tools through the context menu by right-clicking the miniatures with the extended UI
XmlUI:
<Button position="520 670 -60"   rotation="0 0 -90"  width="300" height="50" color="#00EB03FF" textColor="#000000" fontSize="30"  fontStyle="Bold" onClick="ExtendUI"> Extend KT UI </Button>
<Button position="520 -670 -60"  rotation="0 0 -90"  width="300" height="50" color="#FCEB03FF" textColor="#000000" fontSize="30"  fontStyle="BoldAndItalic" onClick="KTUI_ResetScripts"> Fix Display Issues </Button>

<Text position="-670 670 -60"   rotation="0 0 -90" width="300" height="50" fontSize="30" color="#ffffff" text="TABLE CONTROLS:"></Text>
<Button position="-780 350 -60"  rotation="0 0 -90"  width="300" height="50" fontSize="30" fontStyle="Bold" onClick="SaveAllPositions"> Save Positions </Button>
<Button position="-720 350 -60"  rotation="0 0 -90"  width="300" height="50" fontSize="30" fontStyle="BoldAndItalic" onClick="LoadAllPositions"> Load Positions </Button>
<Button position="-780 670 -60"  rotation="0 0 -90"  width="300" height="50" fontSize="30" fontStyle="Bold" onClick="ReadyAllOperatives"> Ready Operatives </Button>

<Text position="-590 -670 -60"   rotation="0 0 -90" width="300" height="50" fontSize="30" color="#ffffff" text="MAT CONTROLS:"></Text>
<Button position="-640 -670 -60" rotation="0 0 -90"  width="300" height="50" fontSize="30" fontStyle="Bold" onClick="EngageAllOperatives"> All Engage </Button>
<Button position="-700 -670 -60" rotation="0 0 -90"  width="300" height="50" fontSize="30" fontStyle="Bold" onClick="ConcealAllOperatives"> All Conceal </Button>

<Button position="-780 -670 -60" rotation="0 0 -90"  width="300" height="50" color="#e98c4c" fontSize="30" fontStyle="Bold" onClick="CleanAllOperatives"> Remove All Tokens </Button>
